title: Opposites for Kids! Big and Small, Up and Down
intro: Hi, friends! I'm Bloop, and welcome to Bloop's Color Lab!
Today we're learning opposites, things that are as different as can be!
I put on my lab goggles, and I'm ready to learn something new with you.
Can you count with me? One, two, three, four, five!
Ready? Let's wiggle into the lab!

lines: Here's a clue: one friend is huge, and one friend is tiny! Can you guess?
These are opposites: big and small!
This purple jelly friend is big. Look at that big, shiny star!
Big, big, big! As big as can be.
Can you stretch your arms out wide and make yourself big?
Can you guess? Which friend is small?
The little yellow friend! Small body, and a small star.
Let's say it together: BIG AND SMALL!
One more time, nice and loud: BIG AND SMALL! Great job!
An elephant is big. A mouse is small.
Bye-bye, Big and Small! See you soon!
Here's a clue: one thing floats high, and one thing falls low! Can you guess?
These are opposites: up and down!
The red balloon floats up, up, up, toward the sky!
Up is high. Way up high, near the clouds.
Can you reach your hands up high? Higher, higher!
Can you guess? Where does a ball go when you drop it?
Down! The ball falls down, down, down to the floor.
Let's say it together: UP AND DOWN!
One more time, nice and loud: UP AND DOWN! Great job!
Birds fly up in the sky. Rain falls down to the ground.
Bye-bye, Up and Down! See you soon!
Here's a clue: the ball likes to hide inside the box! Can you guess?
These are opposites: in and out!
Peek! The blue ball is in the box.
In, in, in. The ball is inside the box.
Can you hop into a pretend box? Ready? Hop in!
Can you guess? Where is the ball now?
Out! The ball rolled out of the box.
Let's say it together: IN AND OUT!
One more time, nice and loud: IN AND OUT! Great job!
Now hop out of your pretend box! In and out!
Bye-bye, In and Out! See you soon!
Here's a clue: it's a box with a lid on top! Can you guess?
These are opposites: open and closed!
The lid is on top. The box is closed.
Closed tight! Nothing can get in or out.
Can you close your eyes? Now open them! Peekaboo!
Can you guess? What happens when we lift the lid?
It's open! And twinkly stars float out.
Let's say it together: OPEN AND CLOSED!
One more time, nice and loud: OPEN AND CLOSED! Great job!
Doors open and close. Your mouth opens and closes too!
Bye-bye, Open and Closed! See you soon!
Here's a clue: one jar has lots of balls, and one jar has none! Can you guess?
These are opposites: full and empty!
This jar is full of colorful balls. Full to the top!
Full means there's no more room inside.
Can you puff your cheeks full of air? Now blow it all out!
Can you guess? Which jar has nothing inside?
This one! The jar is empty.
Let's say it together: FULL AND EMPTY!
One more time, nice and loud: FULL AND EMPTY! Great job!
A full cup has lots inside. An empty cup has nothing at all.
Bye-bye, Full and Empty! See you soon!

outro: Can you find some opposites at home? Look for big and small things!
Bye, friends! See you in the lab!
